settingsFields.label: Settings
settingsFields.description: YouTube video ID (e.g., dQw4w9WgXcQ)

settingsFields.label: Video ID
settingsFields.description: YouTube video ID (e.g., dQw4w9WgXcQ)

settingsFields.label: Title Level
settingsFields.description: Heading level for the title (h1-h5)

settingsFields.label: Responsive (16:9)
settingsFields.description: A 16:9 aspect ratio mode. Width from Appearance tab will auto-convert to % (e.g., 500px → 500%) height is ignored.

settingsFields.label: Autoplay
settingsFields.description: Automatically start playing the video when the page loads

settingsFields.label: Mute
settingsFields.description: Start video with audio muted

settingsFields.label: Loop
settingsFields.description: Replay video continuously from the beginning when it ends

settingsFields.label: Show Controls
settingsFields.description: Display video player controls (play, pause, volume, etc.)

settingsFields.label: Start Time (seconds)
settingsFields.description: Time in seconds where the video should start playing

settingsFields.label: End Time (seconds)
settingsFields.description: Time in seconds where the video should stop playing

settingsFields.label: Show Fullscreen Button
settingsFields.description: Display the fullscreen button in player controls

settingsFields.label: Disable Keyboard Controls
settingsFields.description: Prevent keyboard shortcuts from controlling the player

settingsFields.label: Auto-Show Captions
settingsFields.description: Automatically display closed captions by default

settingsFields.label: Caption Language
settingsFields.description: ISO 639-1 language code for captions (e.g., en, es, fr)

settingsFields.label: Width
settingsFields.description: You can use any unit (%, px, em, etc). px by default if without unit

settingsFields.label: Height
settingsFields.description: You can use any unit (%, px, em, etc). px by default if without unit

settingsFields.label: Offset X
settingsFields.description: Offset X

settingsFields.label: Offset Y
settingsFields.description: Offset Y

settingsFields.label: Blur
settingsFields.description: Blur Radius

settingsFields.label: Spread
settingsFields.description: Spread Radius

settingsFields.label: Style
settingsFields.description: A script that returns the style of the element as an object. This should conform to CSSProperties

settingsFields.label: On Play
settingsFields.description: Action to execute when the video starts playing

settingsFields.label: On Pause
settingsFields.description: Action to execute when the video is paused

settingsFields.label: On End
settingsFields.description: Action to execute when the video finishes playing

settingsFields.label: On Ready
settingsFields.description: Action to execute when the video player is ready

settingsFields.label: Privacy Mode
settingsFields.description: Use youtube-nocookie.com

settingsFields.label: Play Inline (iOS)
settingsFields.description: Enable inline playback on iOS devices (instead of fullscreen)

settingsFields.label: Require Watch Completion
settingsFields.description: When enabled, the form cannot be submitted until the user watches the entire video. The completion state is stored in the form data.
